units.source_text: 如此申明，虽属无益，但昨夜未能造访，其罪自不容辞。”

en.t: Though saying so may be useless, I cannot excuse my failure to visit last night.”

units.source_text: 又写了一封长信给落叶公主。

en.t: He also wrote a long letter to Princess Ochiba.

units.source_text: 命人从厩中牵出一匹快马，换上随从用的鞍子，

en.t: He ordered a fast horse to be led out from the stable and fitted with an attendant’s saddle,

units.source_text: 派遣前晚那个将监跨马送信，

en.t: then sent the same shogen from the night before to ride it and deliver the letter,

units.source_text: 又低声吩咐他道：“你对他们说：

en.t: and quietly instructed him, “Tell them this:

units.source_text: 我昨夜在六条院住宿，是刚才回三条院的。”

en.t: I spent last night at Rokujo-in and have only just returned to Sanjo-in.”
